name: cloudally-mcp
description: Restore or download every CloudAlly mailbox as it stood on a past date, read each mailbox's backup history, and find failing backups across every customer.

cloudally_client_id.title: CloudAlly API client ID
cloudally_client_id.description: The client-id of your CloudAlly API application (partner portal > Integrations > REST API), sent as the client-id header on every request.

cloudally_client_secret.title: CloudAlly API client secret
cloudally_client_secret.description: The client-secret of the same API application, sent as the client-secret header on every request.

cloudally_access_token.title: Access token (leave blank)
cloudally_access_token.description: Optional override; leave blank. Run `cloudally-cli auth login --partner` (or `auth login` for one company) in a terminal instead, which saves and refreshes the token. A pasted token expires and keeps overriding the saved one.

cloudally_email.title: Company account login email (optional)
cloudally_email.description: Optional. Company account login used by `auth login`; every command is then limited to that one company. Most operators run `auth login` once in a terminal and leave this blank.

cloudally_password.title: Company account login password (optional)
cloudally_password.description: Optional. Password for the company account login above.

cloudally_partner_email.title: Partner portal login email (optional)
cloudally_partner_email.description: Optional. Partner portal login used by `auth login --partner`; it reaches every customer account and is needed for the distributor and reseller commands, `auth use-account`, past backup dates and downloads.

cloudally_partner_password.title: Partner portal login password (optional)
cloudally_partner_password.description: Optional. Password for the partner portal login above.

cloudally_base_url.title: Base URL override (testing)
cloudally_base_url.description: Optional; leave blank. Sends every CloudAlly API call to this base URL instead of https://api.cloudally.com, for tests and mock servers.

cloudally_portal_url.title: Portal URL override (testing)
cloudally_portal_url.description: Optional; leave blank. The customer portal origin used for past backup dates, restores resolved from them and downloads (default https://app.cloudally.com). It must be https (plain http only on a loopback test host), and portal credentials go only to https://app.cloudally.com or the CLOUDALLY_BASE_URL origin, so any other portal is refused before anything is sent. Needed when CLOUDALLY_BASE_URL points away from api.cloudally.com: portal commands then refuse to assume the production portal.

cloudally_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
cloudally_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to list only read-only tools: it removes cloudally_execute, restore_submit, download_submit, download_start, download_link, sync, export, workflow_archive, jobs_prune and the learn-store writers, and cloudally_read refuses every state-changing endpoint. The tools it keeps can still write the learn journal and create an empty local store.

cloudally_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
cloudally_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

cloudally_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
cloudally_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Leave blank for Claude Desktop.

cloudally_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cloudally_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to CloudAlly. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
